task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS region from an S3 bucket URL in the format 's3://bucket-name.region.amazonaws.com'. The function should return the region string.
Create a JSON object that represents an AWS Lambda function configuration with environment variables for database credentials (DB_HOST, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD) and a timeout of 60 seconds.

Write a Regex pattern that matches valid AWS IAM role ARNs in the format 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/role-name', where the account ID is 12 digits and role names can contain alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and forward slashes.
